findings.title: Does not match does not hold the visit
findings.description: doesNotMatch only writes an alert. The visit stays parked and can still be released by anyone who scans it.
findings.evidence: Code inspection: doesNotMatch calls raiseNoMatch only; no status change or block in releaseVisit.
findings.reproduction: Scan a pass, tap Does not match, scan the same pass on another attendant account: Release car is offered.
findings.impact: The screen says Car held; the car can still be released, weakening the theft check.
findings.remediation: Add a hold state (or open no_match alert check) that blocks Release until a coordinator clears it with a reason. Needs approval of a decision change.
findings.verification_test: e2e: second attendant cannot release a held visit; coordinator clears with a reason
findings.status_note: fixed: hold_visit / clear_hold, release refuses a held visit (D-18)

findings.title: No security response headers
findings.description: No CSP, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, X-Content-Type-Options, HSTS or Permissions-Policy; X-Powered-By is sent.
findings.evidence: Production server (next start) response headers read with a script; only /p/* sets Referrer-Policy and Cache-Control.
findings.impact: Release screen can be framed; no defence in depth against script injection.
findings.remediation: Add headers in next.config.ts, poweredByHeader false, HSTS on the production host.
findings.status_note: fixed: security headers added in next.config.ts; HSTS applies in production only

findings.title: No admin way to reset a locked member PIN or deactivate staff
findings.description: Lockout after 15 failures and staff deactivation both depend on an admin action that has no screen.
findings.evidence: No route under /admin other than areas; staff made by scripts/seed-admin.ts.
findings.impact: Locked members and staff changes need database access.
findings.remediation: Build staff and member management with audit rows.
findings.verification_test: e2e: admin resets a locked member and deactivates staff
findings.status_note: fixed: /admin/staff and /admin/members

findings.title: Dev-only dependency advisory (braces)
findings.description: pnpm audit reports one high advisory with no patched version.
findings.impact: Development tooling only; not in the production bundle.
findings.remediation: Update when a patch exists.

findings.title: No retention job for guest data
findings.description: Nothing deletes guest visits and guests after 24 months.
findings.evidence: Only midnight-close and rate_events clean-up are scheduled in the migrations.
findings.impact: Personal data kept beyond the stated period (NDPA design exposure).
findings.remediation: Daily pg_cron job plus test.
findings.verification_test: Seed a 25-month-old guest, run the job, assert deleted
findings.status_note: fixed: delete_expired_guest_data + daily cron (D-20)

findings.title: Sign out does not revoke the staff token
findings.description: endStaffSession deletes the cookie only; a copied cookie is valid until expiry unless the account is deactivated.
findings.impact: Stolen cookie works for up to 12 hours.
findings.remediation: Document in training, or add a session version on the staff row.

findings.title: Deployment security requirements unverified
findings.description: Client-IP header handling and path-log redaction for /p/* cannot be checked without a host.
findings.impact: Rate limits or token logging could be wrong in production.
findings.remediation: Verify on staging.

findings.title: Concurrent release not tested against the real database
findings.description: Atomic release is proven only by a unit test with an in-memory store and by reading the SQL.
findings.impact: Likely correct but unproven where it matters.
findings.remediation: Add a parallel release test on a synthetic visit.
findings.verification_test: Two parallel RPC calls: exactly one returns an id
findings.status_note: fixed: live-database parallel release test added

findings.title: QR signs cannot be printed
findings.description: No route or component builds printable A4 signs per area.
findings.evidence: lib/qr.ts is used only by the pass page; no admin sign route exists.
findings.impact: Drivers cannot reach check-in in the car park.
findings.remediation: Build /admin/signs with church name, logo and large area name.
findings.verification_test: Print and scan at 1.5 m in daylight
findings.status_note: fixed: /admin/signs and /admin/signs/[slug]

findings.title: No reports or CSV export
findings.description: Reports per service, area and Sunday, missed check-outs, releases without a pass, CSV export and export logging are missing.
findings.evidence: No report route or CSV code exists.
findings.impact: Pilot success measures cannot be produced.
findings.remediation: Build reports and CSV with logged exports.
findings.verification_test: Reconcile report numbers to the database; open CSV in Excel
findings.status_note: fixed: /admin/reports and CSV export, export logged

findings.title: No staff or member PIN management
findings.description: Staff accounts and member PIN resets cannot be managed in the app.
findings.impact: Operations need database access.
findings.remediation: Build admin staff and member screens.
findings.status_note: fixed: /admin/staff and /admin/members

findings.title: Services cannot be managed
findings.description: Only car-park renaming exists. Services change by database edit or script.
findings.impact: Changing service times needs a developer.
findings.remediation: Build service management.
findings.status_note: fixed: /admin/services

findings.title: Guest retention not implemented
findings.description: Same root cause as SEC-05.
findings.impact: See SEC-05.
findings.remediation: See SEC-05.
findings.status_note: fixed: see SEC-05

findings.title: Camera scanner unproven on a real phone
findings.description: On a plain http network address the browser refuses the camera. No real decode of a pass has been done on a device, in sunlight, or at distance.
findings.evidence: Console error observed: Camera streaming not supported by the browser.
findings.reproduction: Open /staff/scan over http://192.168.x.x on a phone.
findings.impact: The core exit tool is unproven in the field.
findings.remediation: Test over https on Android and iPhone.

findings.title: Camera restarts after every result
findings.description: The scanner stops the camera when a result shows and starts it again for the next scan.
findings.impact: Possible per-car delay; unmeasured.
findings.remediation: Keep the stream alive between scans.
findings.verification_test: Timed run on a real phone

findings.title: Unexplained one-off layout failure
findings.description: history at 320px: text spills out of its box failed once, then passed.
findings.impact: Possible intermittent overflow or test timing.
findings.remediation: Investigate with repeated runs.

findings.title: No accessibility audit
findings.description: Only a design-token contrast test exists. No axe, keyboard, screen-reader, text-scaling or sunlight checks.
findings.impact: Unknown accessibility problems.
findings.remediation: Add axe to Playwright and do a manual pass.
findings.verification_test: axe clean; manual TalkBack and VoiceOver notes
findings.status_note: axe scan covers every screen including the result card, owner pass and new admin screens, and passes. A real structural problem in the fact list was found and fixed. Keyboard, screen reader and sunlight checks still manual.

findings.title: Pass expiry not enforced inside release_visit
findings.description: The date check is in application code only.
findings.impact: A future code path could skip the check.
findings.remediation: Pass the service date into the function.
findings.status_note: fixed: release_visit takes the service date

findings.title: Midnight job not observed running
findings.description: Schedule is correct for Lagos time but has not been observed firing.
findings.impact: Open visits could carry past midnight if the job fails.
findings.remediation: Check the cron run log after the first midnight.

findings.title: First-load JavaScript over budget
findings.description: 196 KB gzip on /c/cp1 against a 150 KB budget.
findings.evidence: Production build; gzip of all script tags: /c/cp1 196 KB, /staff/scan 200 KB, / 190 KB.
findings.reproduction: next start, run the measurement script.
findings.impact: Slower first load on 3G.
findings.remediation: Inspect the shared chunks and trim.
findings.status_note: re-measured: about 157 KB gzip for modern browsers once the legacy-browser polyfill file (39 KB, not downloaded by current phones) is left out; still over the 150 KB budget

findings.title: Chained database calls dominate action time
findings.description: Check-in makes about 9 to 12 sequential database calls; measured round trip is 212 to 300 ms.
findings.evidence: Call count from code; round trip from 8 timed samples.
findings.impact: Estimated 2 to 3 s of server time per check-in on this network.
findings.remediation: Single SQL function per action; parallel independent reads.
findings.status_note: claim_guest_visit and claim_member_visit: a check-in is one database call (D-21). Median tap-to-pass 2.9 s to 1.4 s.

findings.title: Load and 3G targets not verified
findings.description: 300 check-ins in 20 minutes, 3G load time and dashboard load were not tested.
findings.impact: Unknown behaviour under Sunday load.
findings.remediation: Load test on staging with a paid database.
findings.status_note: Measured: 300 check-ins in 99 s with 0 failures, median 2.0 s, board caught up in 1.2 s; check-in page usable in 1.88 s on Lighthouse 3G, 3.0 s on DevTools Fast 3G, 10.4 s on Slow 3G. Repeat on staging; real-device and real-network tests still to do.

findings.title: No deployment, CI, backups or attendant guide
findings.description: Roadmap M8 not started. No host, production database, CI, backup plan, attendant one-page guide or paper-fallback procedure.
findings.impact: No way to run a pilot.
findings.remediation: Deploy staging and production, add CI, write the guide.
findings.status_note: partly fixed: CI workflow and attendant guide added; hosting, production database and backups still to do

findings.title: End-to-end suite slow and environment-coupled
findings.description: About 18 minutes, uses the shared dev database, cannot run beside a dev server.
findings.impact: Slower fixes, flaky risk.
findings.remediation: Dedicated test project and parallel-safe data.
findings.status_note: Test staff accounts are now removed after every run; the sign-up limit no longer trips a full run. The suite is still about 21 minutes and uses the shared dev database.

findings.title: No next step after Does not match
findings.description: The Car held screen does not say what the attendant does next.
findings.impact: Attendants may improvise.
findings.remediation: Add a line such as Stay with the car and call the coordinator.
findings.status_note: fixed: Car held now tells the attendant to stay with the car and call the coordinator

findings.title: Mockup extras intentionally not built
findings.description: Torch, Contact an attendant, View all, View details, My Profile are not built.
findings.impact: None for the spec.
findings.remediation: Decide if wanted.

findings.title: Collapse check-in database calls into single functions
findings.description: See PERF-02.
findings.impact: Server time about 2 s to about 0.5 s (estimate).
findings.remediation: Single SQL claim function.
findings.status_note: see PERF-02

findings.title: Hide the guest service picker behind Change
findings.description: Guests see a service dropdown although R-1 chooses.
findings.impact: One fewer decision.
findings.remediation: Show the chosen service with a Change link.
findings.status_note: fixed

findings.title: Keep the camera stream alive between scans
findings.description: See FUN-07.
findings.impact: Faster next scan (to measure).
findings.remediation: Pause instead of stop.

findings.title: Offer Add car when a search finds nothing
findings.description: No next step after No car found today.
findings.impact: Fewer dead ends.
findings.remediation: Link to Add car with the plate filled.
findings.status_note: fixed

findings.title: Remember the last area on registration
findings.description: Area is chosen every time.
findings.impact: One field fewer.
findings.remediation: Preselect last area on the device.
findings.status_note: fixed

findings.title: Safe bulk Still here in the sweep
findings.description: One tap per car on long lists.
findings.impact: Faster large sweeps.
findings.remediation: Mark the rest Still here with a count confirmation, one audit row per visit. Never bulk Gone or release.
findings.status_note: fixed: Mark the rest Still here with confirmation; Gone is never bulk

findings.title: Open-alert count on the coordinator tab bar
findings.description: Alerts only appear on the Live screen.
findings.impact: Urgent issues visible at once.
findings.remediation: Badge with the unresolved count.
findings.status_note: partly: the admin overview shows the open-exceptions count; no live badge on the tab bar

findings.title: Optional auto-return to the scanner after release
findings.description: Scan next pass requires a tap.
findings.impact: One tap fewer, risk of missed confirmation.
findings.remediation: Only after usability testing.

findings.title: Analytics, Vehicles, Visit details and Settings screens from the dashboard design
findings.description: Built from real records and tested (D-22).
findings.impact: n/a
findings.remediation: n/a
findings.status_note: built

findings.title: Test staff clutter in the dev database
findings.description: Tests left hundreds of switched-off staff accounts.
findings.impact: A long Staff Accounts list.
findings.remediation: purgeTestStaff in teardown and pnpm db:purge-test-staff
findings.verification_test: staff list holds only real accounts after a run
findings.status_note: fixed

findings.title: Sign-up limit of 60 an hour per address may be low for church wifi
findings.description: A congregation signing up from one wifi on one morning could reach the limit.
findings.evidence: code comment calls it generous; a full test run reached it
findings.reproduction: 61 sign-ups from one address in an hour
findings.impact: Some members told to try later.
findings.remediation: Decide a value, such as 150 an hour like check-ins.
